1101: Command-line utility for querying and managing flag configurations in the Windows Configuration System (WinCS).
1104: Queries flag configurations on the offline image.
1105:
/Query-WinCs [/Key:<key>]

  <key> is optional and can be:
    - A full configuration key (e.g. A1CDB08F001)
    - A hex flag ID (e.g. A1CDB08F)
    - A decimal flag ID (original or obfuscated)
  If omitted, all flags are returned.
1107: Enables a feature flag on the offline image.
1108:
/Enable-WinCs /Key:<id> [/Variant:<n>]

  <id> (REQUIRED) can be:
    - A hex flag ID (e.g. A1CDB08F)
    - A decimal flag ID (original or obfuscated)

  Options:
    /Variant:<n>  The variant ID (0-255).
1110: Disables a feature flag on the offline image.
1111:
/Disable-WinCs /Key:<id>

  <id> (REQUIRED) can be:
    - A hex flag ID (e.g. A1CDB08F)
    - A decimal flag ID (original or obfuscated)
1113: Resets a flag to its default configuration on the offline image.
1114:
/Reset-WinCs /Key:<key>

  <key> (REQUIRED) can be:
    - A full configuration key (e.g. A1CDB08F001)
    - A hex flag ID (e.g. A1CDB08F)
    - A decimal flag ID (original or obfuscated)
1116: Applies a full flag configuration to the offline image.
1117:
/Apply-WinCs /Key:<configuration>

  <configuration> (REQUIRED) must be a full configuration key (e.g. A1CDB08F001)
  that encodes the obfuscated ID, variant, and enablement state.

  To enable or disable a flag by ID, use /Enable-WinCs or /Disable-WinCs instead.
1119: Adds inventory entries from a signed JSON artifact.
1120:
/Add-WinCs /Artifact:<path> [/Key:<id>]

  <path> (REQUIRED) path to a signed JSON artifact.

  The artifact is a signed JSON document encoding one or more WinCS inventory entries.
  When /Key is omitted, all features in the artifact are added.
  When /Key is provided, only the matching feature is added.
1122: Removes inventory entries from a signed JSON artifact.
1123:
/Remove-WinCs /Artifact:<path> [/Key:<id>]

  <path> (REQUIRED) path to a signed JSON artifact.

  When /Key is omitted, all features in the artifact are removed.
  When /Key is provided, only the matching feature is removed.
